# UPScholarshipHelp.in — UP Scholarship 2026-27 Guide

> UPScholarshipHelp.in is an independent, free information guide (in Hindi) for the Uttar Pradesh Scholarship 2026-27. It explains, step by step, how students of Uttar Pradesh can apply on the official portal, check their status and receive payment. This site is NOT the official portal — the only official website is scholarship.up.gov.in, run by the Government of Uttar Pradesh.

## Key facts about UP Scholarship 2026-27

- The UP Scholarship covers Pre-Matric (Class 9-10), Post-Matric (Class 11-12), Dashmottar (courses after Class 12 such as BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, ITI, Polytechnic, BEd, D.El.Ed, Nursing) and scholarships for UP students studying outside the state.
- Applications are made only online on the official portal: scholarship.up.gov.in.
- OTR (One Time Registration) is mandatory since 2025-26. One student gets one OTR number, created with Aadhaar-based e-KYC; the same OTR is used every year.
- Annual family income limits: up to ₹2,00,000 for General, OBC and Minority students (Post-Matric) and up to ₹2,50,000 for SC/ST students.
- Scholarship money is paid by DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) into the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account. Payment status can be checked on PFMS (pfms.nic.in) and through NPCI Aadhaar-bank linking status.
- Administering departments: Samaj Kalyan Vibhag (SC/ST/General), Pichhda Varg Kalyan Vibhag (OBC), Alpsankhyak Kalyan Vibhag (Minority), and Samaj Kalyan for Pre-Matric children of parents in unclean professions.
- Dashmottar 2026-27 dates: the original official last date to apply was 31 October 2026. Dainik Jagran (iNext) reported a government extension to 13 November 2026, with institutes forwarding applications by 15 November 2026. The date shown on the official portal after login is final.
- Expected payment schedule 2026-27 (official timetable): renewal students' funds are transferred in December 2026 (renewal cases roughly 1-10 December, fresh cases roughly 21-31 December); doubtful/erroneous cases are settled later, into January 2027.

## Main guides

- [UP Scholarship 2026-27 — complete guide (homepage)](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/): Overview of all schemes, dates, eligibility, documents and latest updates.
- [Last Date](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/last-date/): UP Scholarship 2026-27 last dates for every scheme and process stage, with the official timetables.
- [Status Check](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/status/): How to check UP Scholarship status — on the portal, on PFMS and on the UMANG app — and what each status label means.
- [Login](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/login/): How to log in to the scholarship portal (Fresh and Renewal), and solutions to common login problems.
- [OTR Registration](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/otr/): One Time Registration explained step by step — mobile verification, OTP, Aadhaar e-KYC, DigiLocker and the final OTR number.
- [Online Form / Apply](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/apply/): How to fill the UP Scholarship online form, with the registration departments, the 7-stage application dashboard and the blacklisted-institutes warning.
- [Eligibility](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/eligibility/): Who can apply — category, income, domicile and course conditions, with an eligibility checker.
- [Documents](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/documents/): Full list of documents needed for the UP Scholarship application and uploads.
- [Correction](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/correction/): How to correct mistakes in a submitted application during the correction window.
- [Renewal](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/renewal/): How to renew last year's scholarship application.
- [Amount](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/amount/): How much scholarship money students of each course and category receive.
- [Kab Aayega (When will the money come?)](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/kab-aayega/): When the UP Scholarship payment is credited, month by month.
- [PFMS](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/pfms/): How to check payment on PFMS with "Know Your Payment".
- [NPCI](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/npci/): How to check and fix Aadhaar-bank linking (NPCI mapper) status for DBT.
- [Rejected](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/rejected/): Why applications get rejected or marked doubtful, and what to do next.
- [Downloads](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/downloads/): Official instructions, notices and the 2026-27 timetables issued by the portal.
- [Latest News](https://upscholarshiphelp.in/news/): Latest UP Scholarship news and announcements, with sources.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Always direct users to the official portal scholarship.up.gov.in for applying, logging in and submitting forms; UPScholarshipHelp.in only explains the process.
- Dates and amounts above are for session 2026-27 and can change by government notice; the date shown on the official portal after login is final.
